claims.content: If the Customer attempts to retract a bid after it has been placed, the system blocks the retraction according to the explicit policy that auction bids may not be cancelled once placed.

If the Customer has already confirmed the bid via the Bid Confirmation Pop-up (e.g., by clicking 'Yes, Place SmartBid'), the system provides no further cancellation option; the user remains on the bidding page with no UI or mechanism available to retract the confirmed bid.

If the Customer clicks the 'CANCEL' button in the Bid Confirmation Pop-up instead of confirming the bid, the system prevents the bid from being placed or confirmed, retracting the intended action before a binding bid is created.

If the Customer attempts to retract a confirmed bid from the Customer History Page, the page displays bid history (active and closed bids with timestamps) but provides no UI controls or buttons to retract or cancel any confirmed bid.

If the Customer attempts to retract a bid via the Order History page, the page shows only order-level cancellations (e.g., status 'Order Cancelled'), which are distinct from bid retractions, and provides no mechanism to initiate a bid retraction during an auction.

claims.content: The Customer wants to retract a confirmed bid — i.e., to cancel a bid that they previously placed as a bidder during an auction.
The Customer is signed in as a bidder.
The Customer has a confirmed bid in the auction, placed earlier via SmartBid or Single Bid and explicitly confirmed.
The auction containing that confirmed bid is still open for bidding (time remains on the auction).
The trigger for the 'Retract a Confirmed Bid' use case is the Customer navigating to and selecting the 'My Current Bids' page from within their account area.
If the Customer attempts to retract a bid after it has been placed, the system blocks the retraction according to the explicit policy that auction bids may not be cancelled once placed.

If the Customer has already confirmed the bid via the Bid Confirmation Pop-up (e.g., by clicking 'Yes, Place SmartBid'), the system provides no further cancellation option; the user remains on the bidding page with no UI or mechanism available to retract the confirmed bid.

If the Customer clicks the 'CANCEL' button in the Bid Confirmation Pop-up instead of confirming the bid, the system prevents the bid from being placed or confirmed, retracting the intended action before a binding bid is created.

If the Customer attempts to retract a confirmed bid from the Customer History Page, the page displays bid history (active and closed bids with timestamps) but provides no UI controls or buttons to retract or cancel any confirmed bid.

If the Customer attempts to retract a bid via the Order History page, the page shows only order-level cancellations (e.g., status 'Order Cancelled'), which are distinct from bid retractions, and provides no mechanism to initiate a bid retraction during an auction.

The system does not produce a successful retraction state: confirmed auction bids are binding and cannot be cancelled after placement, so the final system state is the persistence of the original confirmed bid unchanged.
